title: Miami Developer
summary: Case study: Silver Oak Capital arranged a USD 10 million long-term commercial mortgage at 70% loan-to-value for a property development company specialising in waterfront properties in Miami, Florida. The borrower approached the firm for help purchasing a new residential building in the Brickell neighbourhood of Miami. Reported terms: interest rate of 4.25% above Bank Prime Rate, 7-year term, interest-only for the first five years then amortised over 20 years, and a 1.5% bank fee. The lender's package is described as accounting for coastal and hurricane risks (sea-level rise mitigation measures, adherence to strict coastal development regulations, hurricane stability). The lender is not named and no completion date is given in the search results; the search engine reported the page as about 37 days old (roughly late September 2026), which may be a last-modified date rather than the deal date. No independent coverage of the deal was found.
